nodes.role: Single CLI binary. Parses flags, dispatches subcommands (scan, integrate, evidence, fix, progress, compare, cache, update, version), drives a provider scanner, then renders text/json/html/pdf/csv output.

2630 lines in a single file; duplicates the ComplianceResult/ControlResult structs that pkg/core also defines.
Does not use pkg/core or pkg/providers — it calls the pkg/aws, pkg/azure, pkg/gcp scanners directly.

nodes.role: Consent banner and preference modal. Owns the consent state in localStorage and is the only place that injects the Google tag script.
constraints: gtag is defined only inside loadGtag (cookie-consent.js:40-41), and loadGtag runs only when prefs.analytics is true (cookie-consent.js:29). With analytics consent off, window.gtag is undefined.
The tag ID is AW-17730440946 — a Google Ads conversion ID format. No GA4 (G-) or Universal Analytics (UA-) measurement ID appears anywhere in the repo.
Consent is stored in localStorage under the key auditkit_cookie_consent; there is no server-side consent record.
What the loaded gtag.js sends to Google is not determinable from this repo.

nodes.role: Stripe — the payments provider. Present ONLY as a hosted Stripe Payment Link in <a href> attributes on the marketing site.
constraints: No Stripe SDK, no js.stripe.com script, no pk_live/pk_test/sk_live/sk_test/whsec_ key, no webhook handler, and no Go or JS code that calls Stripe: searched every tracked file for each of those patterns, zero matches.
The relationship is a user clicking a hyperlink out to a Stripe-hosted checkout page. Checkout, billing and subscription state live entirely on Stripe's side and are not represented in this repo.
34 occurrences across 26 tracked files (25 .html pages + README.md), all the same Payment Link path. Verified over every tracked file, not a sample.
Each CTA also carries an inline onclick that fires a Google Ads conversion event, gated on window.auditKitConsent.marketing and typeof gtag === 'function'.

nodes.role: Google tag (gtag.js) loaded from googletagmanager.com with the Google Ads conversion ID AW-17730440946. This is the analytics/measurement service in the repo.
constraints: The ID is in Google Ads conversion-ID format (AW-). Searching every tracked file for G-[A-Z0-9]{6,}, UA-[0-9]+ and GTM-[A-Z0-9]+ returns zero matches, so calling this "Google Analytics" or "Tag Manager" would not be supported by the source.
The script is injected only after the visitor grants analytics consent (cookie-consent.js:29).
The only event this repo fires is gtag('event', 'conversion', ...) on the Stripe CTA, 33 occurrences and no other gtag event name anywhere; it additionally requires marketing consent.

The scanner binaries contain no telemetry: no .go file imports opentelemetry or otel (they appear in go.sum only as indirect dependencies of the cloud SDKs), and the only http.Get in scanner/ is the GitHub release check.
